recoveryInstructions.streamFailure: If a stream stalls, execute 'node scripts/manage_judge_demo.js restart-stream <cameraId>'. MediaMTX will resume publication within 2 seconds.
recoveryInstructions.aiWorkerStall: Restart AI worker; the Redis Stream consumer group maintains offset without losing processed frame states.
recoveryInstructions.cleanReset: Execute 'node scripts/manage_judge_demo.js reset' to purge demonstration sightings and alerts without affecting migrations, user accounts, or camera topology.
